comments.author: Phil C.
comments.html:
One definitely hopes so! I am definitely enjoying the frequent updates.

I want to punch both of the characters in this one. You’ve definitely succeeded in making them BOTH narcissistic and shallow. 🙂

cheers,
Phil

comments.author: Mister E
comments.html: Man, I just discovered ES & D and it is rapidly becoming one of my fave web comics. There’s sadness in there, and deep cynicism, but the hope for something better, and best of all sick, dark, depraved humor. Best of all is the acute social commentary-every time I laugh at how completely you’ve skewered the hypocrisy of some subset of our society, I recognize myself in the next comic and wither in shame and self-loathing. Thank God someone understands and can articulate it so well. Anyway, this is getting super gay, so I’ll stop. But good job.

comments.author: Mister E
comments.html: Shit. I said two things were “best of all.” Shit. Fuck. Sorry.

comments.author: jomul7
comments.html: WOW, I’m just going back all the issues and just remaining in awe of your work. I have always loved comics and critical thinking and here I get both! This must be paradise, right?
